# 0.9.1 — security and CI fixes

Clears the two failures reported by the deploy jobs (the `Security` workflow).

## govulncheck

- **Go toolchain bumped to 1.26.8** (`go.mod` and the `golang:1.26.8-alpine`
  build stage). This clears the 26 standard-library advisories that affected
  `go1.26` (crypto/tls, crypto/x509, net/http, net/url, net/mail, net/textproto,
  encoding/xml, encoding/asn1, html/template, os, mime).
- **`github.com/quic-go/quic-go` v0.59.0 → v0.59.1** (GO-2026-5676, HTTP/3 QPACK
  trailer-expansion memory exhaustion).

`govulncheck ./...` now reports **0 reachable vulnerabilities**.

## gitleaks

- The `jsonx` benchmark fixture used a realistic-looking instance token, which
  the default `generic-api-key` rule flagged. It now uses an all-zero UUID, and
  a `.gitleaks.toml` allowlists that benchmark file (extending the default
  rules, so real secrets are still caught).

## Container image

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/felipeestevanatto/wamux:0.9.1
```

No API or data changes.
